description: XSUAA config = LEFT arrow in diagram (xsuaa -> XSUAA Service). Maps JWT scopes to CAP roles used in @restrict.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Viewer
scopes.description: Read books / incidents. Maps to @restrict to:'Viewer'. Given to bob + alice.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Support
scopes.description: Work incidents. Maps to @restrict to:'Support'. Given to erin.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.admin
scopes.description: Full access (*). Maps to @restrict to:'admin'. Given to alice only. Keep this group tiny.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Copied from IAS user store into JWT -> req.user.attr.department -> row filter in service.js

role-collections.name: Bookstore-Viewer
role-collections.description: Assign to bob in BTP cockpit

role-collections.name: Bookstore-Admin
role-collections.description: Assign to alice in BTP cockpit. Requires IAS group or IdP mapping.
